title: Compaction Failure: Conversation Length Exceeds Processing Limit
body:

/compact

     Press esc to go up a few messages and try again.

**Environment Info**

top_comments.author: jmarbutt
top_comments.body: I am having this also, did you find a solution?

top_comments.author: pattihis
top_comments.body:
The error message is missing the **twice**. 

You can hit `esc` **twice**, it will bring up a list of your past prompts, you can go up to previous messages and run the `/compact` earlier.
